So numericIndicator will be null leading NullPointerException. But tests not run.

Simplify: make class public, import JUnit Jupiter annotations. Use @BeforeAll, @BeforeEach, @AfterAll. Also remove static numFunction if not used, but keep.

Also need to ensure NumericIndicator.of works with IndexIndicator. Ensure we have correct imports.

Now code compile? Need to have org.ta4j.core.indicators.numeric.NumericIndicator class available. Assume library present.

Make test class public.

Also need to ensure plus method throws NullPointerException when null argument. Implementation likely does that.

Thus corrected code:

Make class public, add proper annotations, uncomment them.
